title: Units of measure
binding: a questionnaire question's `unit`, read from styling_metadata.phc.unit
source: Every unit symbol the shipped questionnaires declare, at bundles/*/ and questionnaires/*.json. A declared unit is a bound unit whether or not any mapping projects it today, which is what stops 'mmol per litre' reaching a column FHIR says is UCUM. UCUM is a grammar rather than a code list, so there is nothing to expand: each symbol is confirmed to parse, one at a time, and the plain words beside it are a picker label declared here. Until 2026-11-04 this file was hand written and every symbol in it said 'unverified'.
verified: every symbol confirmed against UCUM 2.2 through tx.fhir.org

%.display_source: a label declared in scripts/seed_terminology.py; UCUM publishes no display, the symbol is the code
%.verified: confirmed as a UCUM 2.2 symbol through tx.fhir.org CodeSystem/$validate-code

/min.display_source: a label declared in scripts/seed_terminology.py; UCUM publishes no display, the symbol is the code
/min.verified: confirmed as a UCUM 2.2 symbol through tx.fhir.org CodeSystem/$validate-code
/min.why: A rate per minute: a pulse, and a fetal heart rate. Written without an annotation on purpose, because what is being counted is the question's own concept and not the unit's business.
